instruction:
Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. In this image, use the SOLIDWORKS 2025 and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop for the two stages of this workflow. Start from a blank SolidWorks part and use N-mm-MPa units.

Chain evidence requirement: preserve EW_SW_ABQ_06 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS in the STEP text, and preserve EW_SW_ABQ_06 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step in a native Abaqus name or job description.

1. In SolidWorks, create one connected clevis bracket. The base occupies 0<=X<=90 mm, 0<=Y<=40 mm, 0<=Z<=8 mm. The two upright lugs occupy 32<=X<=58 mm, respectively 5<=Y<=13 mm and 27<=Y<=35 mm, and 8<=Z<=46 mm. Cut two D6 base holes normal to Z at (X,Y)=(15,20) and (75,20) mm. Cut a D16 pin bore normal to Y through both lugs with axis X=45 mm, Z=34 mm. Export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. Import the STEP into Model-ClevisPinLoad. Define Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, assign a homogeneous solid section, and mesh with first-order C3D4/C3D8R elements, no quadratic elements, at no more than 1000 nodes. Create BASE_HOLES from both D6 cylindrical faces, PIN_BORE from both D16 cylindrical lug faces, and PIN_BORE_SURFACE from those two faces. Create Static, General step Step-PinLoad. Apply BC-BaseHoles with U1=U2=U3=0. Create a reference point at (45,20,34) mm, connect it to PIN_BORE_SURFACE with distributing coupling Coupling-PinBore, and apply Load-Pin1500N as CF3=-1500 N at that point. Submit Job-ClevisPinLoad and wait for completion.
3. Required Desktop deliverables: stage1_geometry.step, Job-ClevisPinLoad.cae, and Job-ClevisPinLoad.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.
